title: BinanceLiquidationAccumulator: drain logQueue on shutdown before interrupting logWriter
goal: Fix the shutdown queue-drop defect in src/main/java/datafeed/BinanceLiquidationAccumulator.java:80-92,219-224 uncovered by CRITICAL_24H_AUDIT_2026-10-30.md Finding 4: shutdown() sets running=false and immediately calls logWriter.interrupt(), which causes logLoop() to exit on InterruptedException at logQueue.poll(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS) without draining remaining queued liquidation events in logQueue.
steps: In BinanceLiquidationAccumulator.java:80-92, ensure that when InterruptedException occurs or running becomes false, logLoop() drains any remaining strings in logQueue and flushes the BufferedWriter before closing.
In shutdown() (lines 219-224), join logWriter briefly (e.g. logWriter.join(2000)) after interrupting so queued events are guaranteed to be on disk when shutdown() returns.
Extend LiquidationLogWiringTest.java to assert that liquidation events enqueued right before shutdown() are flushed to the .jsonl file.
done_when: mvn -q -Dtest=LiquidationLogWiringTest test passes with a test verifying all queued liquidation events are flushed on shutdown().
notes: Filed by Gemini 4 Argon (Low) 24h critical audit (MTS-20261030-GEM-AUD-gemini-24h-critical-audit).
